Independent binomial-weight enumeration and reconstruction of the finite-rank argument
correctness.rationale: The probability of at least one block with exactly j red vertices is 1−exp(−m_b[−log(1−p_{j,b})]); since p_{j,b} tends to zero, convergence of this probability is equivalent to extended convergence of m_b p_{j,b}. Consecutive binomial point probabilities have ratio (b−j)/(j+1), so a positive finite limit fixes the limits at every other fixed index. The two complementary critical counts occupy disjoint multinomial cells for b>2k and their generating function factors in the limit. Zero and diverging means give absence and eventual saturation by the first- and second-moment bounds. In the q-round game, keep a one-to-one pairing of visited blocks and pair the pebbled individuals with their colours preserved. A repeated vertex must be matched to its previous counterpart; new blocks and new vertices of a colour are always available by the two truncations at q. The central type has binomial success probability tending to one and m_b tends to infinity. The finite profile therefore controls all fixed ranks; each Boolean threshold event is expressible by distinct class representatives. Canonical effectivity follows by evaluating the sentence on one finite representative of each possible profile and summing finite Poisson probabilities and their complements. My separate binomial-weight enumeration at b=5, m=4, k=1 checked the entire joint law and obtained exact probability 109975/524288 for both rare kinds present.
residual_risks: The finite replay checks a joint law, not the asymptotic argument. Applicability is confined to the stated equipotent fair-colour model and first-order vocabulary.

originality.rationale: The central iff criterion, zero–one classification, critical scale and independent complementary Poisson counts are already covered in the earlier-dated Resultary record b9be2992032a for the same model. This is demonstrated equivalent mathematical coverage, not a claim about authorship or external publication priority. The exact Boolean-threshold spectrum is not explicit in that earlier statement, but is a direct consequence of its finite-rank profile and Poisson-pair description together with the immediate definability of each fixed threshold. The specialization to lambda=1 and an effective rational polynomial in exp(−1) then follows by summing finite Poisson masses and using complements. These do not provide an independently original, valuable remainder of the frozen claim, so no repair is submitted.

value.rationale: The full classification, considered as a mathematical result, resolves convergence and failure of convergence across all growing scales in a natural random unary expansion, and explains why precisely the two complementary extremes control the nondeterministic first-order law. That subject is worthwhile independently of which record supplied the classification. There is no separately valuable repair by retaining just the routine spectrum/notation consequence of the covered classification.
residual_risks: Value of the mathematical question does not establish novelty of this record; the scope does not extend to arbitrary coloured partitions.
